# Re-slice with chunks of 1500
rm /tmp/sh2/*.png
for f in /tmp/sh/*.png; do
  name=$(basename "$f" _small.png)
  height=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 "$f")
  chunk_h=1500
  chunks=$(( (height + chunk_h - 1) / chunk_h ))
  for i in $(seq 0 $((chunks - 1))); do
    y=$((i * chunk_h))
    actual_h=$chunk_h
    if [ $((y + chunk_h)) -gt $height ]; then
      actual_h=$((height - y))
    fi
    ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -vf "crop=800:${actual_h}:0:$y" "/tmp/sh2/${name}_${i}.png" 2>/dev/null
  done
done

What counts as a Monthly Active User (MAU)?

Can I self-host Flexor?

v2.14.0● ACTIVENov 18, 2024

Edge SDK GA — sub-50ms evaluation globally

The Edge SDK is officially production-ready. Deploy your flag rules to 300+ Cloudflare PoPs with a single command. Includes drop-in support for Next.js middleware, Vercel Edge Functions, and Cloudflare Workers.

  • NEW Edge SDK 1.0 with TypeScript, Go, and Rust runtimes
  • IMP Cold start reduced from 47ms → 8ms on Workers
  • FIX Resolved cache invalidation race on rapid flag updates
v2.13.2Nov 6, 2024

PagerDuty integration & richer alert payloads

Route flag-change events directly into PagerDuty services with severity routing rules. Alerts now include the actor, environment, and a diff of targeting rules.

  • NEW PagerDuty v3 events integration with two-way ack
  • IMP Alert payloads now include rule diffs and JSON snapshots
v2.13.0Oct 24, 2024

Bulk flag import & CSV migration tooling

Migrating off LaunchDarkly or Unleash? Import thousands of flags, environments, and targeting rules in one shot using our new CLI command flexor migrate.

  • NEW CSV / JSON bulk import for flags and segments
  • NEW flexor migrate CLI subcommand
  • FIX Pagination off-by-one in /v1/flags list endpoint
v2.12.4Oct 10, 2024

Stats Engine v2 preview & SRM detection

Opt into the new Bayesian stats engine from your project settings. Automatic sample ratio mismatch detection now flags broken experiments before you read them.

  • NEW Bayesian credible intervals on all experiment readouts
  • NEW Automatic SRM detection with severity scoring
v2.12.0Sep 28, 2024

Self-hosted Relay v1 — keep evaluation in your VPC

The Flexor Relay runs as a lightweight Go binary inside your infrastructure, caching flag definitions and serving evaluations with zero external network calls.

  • NEW Relay v1.0.0 with Docker, Helm, and systemd packages
  • IMP Reduced control-plane bandwidth by 90% for large customers

content.text:
All 5 pages built. Each is self-contained with inline CSS (via Google Fonts @import), no external assets, and uses CSS-only visuals for icons/badges/charts:

- **home.html** — hero with gradient title, platform cards, dual-pane code mock, stats, testimonials, pricing teaser
- **features.html** — alternating feature rows with code/chart/event-stream mocks, comparison table, video placeholder with play button, integrations grid, CTA box
- **pricing.html** — pricing tiers (with monthly/annual JS toggle), enterprise card, full plan comparison table, usage/MAU section, FAQ accordion
- **docs.html** — sidebar nav layout, hero stats, terminal codeblocks, language tabs, guide cards, REST endpoint list, help cards
- **blog.html** — featured posts grid with gradient cover art, category filter chips, timeline-style changelog with version badges, newsletter, authors grid

Animations: scroll-triggered reveal via `IntersectionObserver`, hover lift on cards, sticky blurred header, FAQ accordion via `<details>`, billing toggle and category filters with vanilla JS.
